title: Getting started with slumbR
text: example JSON files bundled inst/extdata/. Use system.file() locate : read_study() returns slumbr_study object three slots: $diary — long-format data frame, one row per diary entry $wide — wide-format data frame, one row per participant × night $scores — questionnaire results, one row per participant × instrument

text: study_summary() computes per-participant means across full protocol: contrast participants immediately visible: P002 (James) shows high TST SE P001 (Sarah) P003 (Priya) fall well clinical thresholds.

title: Getting started with slumbR
text: morning entry includes binary flags commonly used clinical thresholds:
code: flags <- study$wide[, c("participant_id", "date",                          "m_sol_flag", "m_se_flag",                          "m_waso_flag", "m_tst_flag")]  # Proportion of nights flagged per participant aggregate(cbind(m_sol_flag, m_se_flag, m_waso_flag, m_tst_flag) ~ participant_id,           data  = flags,           FUN   = function(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)) #>       participant_id m_sol_flag m_se_flag m_waso_flag m_tst_flag #> 1 CIRCADIA-2025-P001       92.3      69.2        38.5       61.5 #> 2 CIRCADIA-2025-P002        0.0       0.0         0.0        0.0 #> 3 CIRCADIA-2025-P003       15.4      38.5        38.5       38.5

title: slumbR — R tools for sleep diary research
text: slumbR official R companion Sleep Diaries app. study ends, participants export data JSON file. slumbR reads files — one per participant whole directory — hands clean, analysis-ready data frame seconds. computes standard sleep variables (TIB, TST, SE, SOL, WASO) directly raw diary answers, re-scores eight validated questionnaires bundled app (ESS, ISI, DBAS-16, MEQ, PSQI, RU-SATED, STOP-BANG, MCTQ), assembles long wide study-level frames ready downstream statistics visualisation.

title: slumbR — R tools for sleep diary research
text: 📥 read_export() — parse single participant’s JSON export structured slumbr_export object 📂 read_study() — batch-read whole directory exports slumbr_study long, wide, scores frames 📐 compute_sleep_vars() — derive TIB, TST, SE, clinical flags raw morning diary answers 🔀 diary_wide() — pivot one row per participant × night m_ / e_ prefixed columns 📊 study_summary() — participant-level summary table (mean TST, SE, SOL, quality, etc.) 🧮 score_questionnaire() — re-score 8 instruments raw answers; algorithms match app exactly ✅ score_all_questionnaires() — re-score entire questionnaire data frame one call
